text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes! A local idol's charm comes from her energy! Please coach me in boxing again today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san,
have you shifted up a gear compared to before...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Your punches have gotten so much more powerful, too...
It really surprised me...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, was that so?
I hadn't even noticed, dear.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: (Is it because Trainer has been coaching me with everything they've got?)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, we'll have to thank Trainer, won't we?
